question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
      AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN t.total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
         ELSE p.promo_net / t.total_net 
    END AS 促销期净销额占比
FROM promo_sales p, total_sales t

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.region,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 总销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.region ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
)
SELECT region AS 大区, sku_name AS 销量最高单品, 总销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数量
FROM (
    SELECT o.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(净销额)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) AS 净销额
            FROM fact_sales s2
            JOIN dim_outlet o2 ON s2.outlet_id = o2.outlet_id
            JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
            WHERE d2.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
            GROUP BY o2.outlet_id
        ) t
    )
) sub

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.year_month = '2026-08' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_aug,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.year_month = '2026-07' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_jul
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-08', '2026-07')

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_sales) AS total FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.region,
    rs.net_sales AS 净销额,
    SUM(rs.net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY rs.net_sales DESC) / ts.total AS 累计占比
FROM region_sales rs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
ORDER BY rs.net_sales DESC

question: 哪些业务代表的有效拜访次数高于平均值

    WHERE fv.is_planned = TRUE

      AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

question: 2026年各月净销额及占全年的比例

    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026
    GROUP BY d.year_month
),
total AS (
    SELECT SUM(月净销额) AS 全年净销额

question: 华东区在2026年8月的铺市率和动销率分别是多少
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.listed_date <= d.full_date AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date > d.full_date) THEN r.outlet_id END) AS 铺市门店数,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.qty > 0 THEN s.outlet_id END) AS 动销门店数,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outlet_id) AS 总门店数,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.listed_date <= d.full_date AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date > d.full_date) THEN r.outlet_id END) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outlet_id), 0) AS 铺市率,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.qty > 0 THEN s.outlet_id END) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.listed_date <= d.full_date AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date > d.full_date) THEN r.outlet_id END), 0) AS 动销率
FROM dim_outlet o
JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year IN (2025, 2026) AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY dl.region, d.year, d.month
)
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END), 0), 2
    ) AS 净销额同比增长率
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT o.channel,
           SUM(s.qty) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id) AS current_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_period AS (
    SELECT o.channel,
           SUM(s.qty) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id) AS last_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
    (c.current_output - l.last_output) / l.last_output AS 单店产出同比变化率
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN last_period l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 渠道

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH cost_2026 AS (
    SELECT SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2)
),
sales_2026 AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2)
),
cost_2025 AS (
    SELECT SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4)
),
sales_2025 AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT 
    (c2026.total_cost / NULLIF(s2026.total_sales, 0)) - (c2025.total_cost / NULLIF(s2025.total_sales, 0)) AS 费效比差值
FROM cost_2026 c2026, sales_2026 s2026, cost_2025 c2025, sales_2025 s2025
